summary: Implemented list, status, logs, and config with a shared read-only model, exact log flag forwarding, EDITOR support, state-preserving reads, 80-column plain-text output, and 28 focused tests.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented list, status, logs, and config with a shared read-only model, exact log flag forwarding, EDITOR support, state-preserving reads, 80-column plain-text output, and 28 focused tests.
decisions: Read commands use StateStore.readCache() with an in-memory rebuild fallback, never load/update/reset, so no state.json is created or modified.
Status label priority is broken, missing, stopped, unhealthy, healthy, unknown; stopped and missing containers are never reported healthy from stale cache data.
status exits 5 for an unknown app and 4 for stopped, missing, or last-recorded unhealthy apps.
config --path prints the absolute config.toml path and verifies it exists; --edit opens the parsed $EDITOR command, waits, then re-validates without applying anything.
The EDITOR value is tokenized into an argument array and spawned without a shell.
logs forwards follow and tail explicitly through the platform Podman adapter and returns ContainerLogsResult.exitCode.
JSON output is additive schemaVersion 1 with redacted [env] values; feature 07 can replace or extend the serializers.
interfaces: runConfigCommand(options): Promise<ExitCode>; formatConfigReport(record, spec); toConfigDocument(record, spec); parseEditorCommand(value); createDefaultEditorRunner()

resolveReadDependencies(overrides); readAppState(store); inspectAppContainer(runtime, app); collectAppRows(entries, dependencies); statusLabel(container, state); statusExitCode(status); redactedSpec(spec); formatField/formatTable/wrapText
warnings: The four handlers are not registered in src/cli/program.ts; command registration remains cli-engineer ownership. They are exported for one-line handler wiring.
The gated Podman integration suite was not run; ADD-1.6 owns that suite.
logs delegates to the platform Podman adapter, which maps typed failures to documented exit codes (2/5); successful results return the adapter's exitCode.
validationLimitations: No real Podman container, editor, or TTY was exercised; runtime, editor, and output streams were injected fakes while the registry and state cache were real temporary files.
payload.taskDescription: Implement the four read commands. list scans the registry, inspects each app container, and prints a compact table with name, status, port, ref, last update, and image; broken apps appear with their error. status takes one app and prints config, image references, probe settings, container state, and last health result. logs passes through podman logs with -f and --tail and exits with podman's code. config prints the config path, validates on request, and opens EDITOR when asked. Tests cover a mixed registry, a missing app, a stopped container, log flag forwarding, and config validation output.
